latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video CapCut — AI-powered, cloud-based video editing for fast social-ready clips.

- Upload raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and receive edited 1080p MP4s with minimal setup.
- Automated editing options: trim, add text overlays, sync cuts to music, and more through simple instructions.
- TikTok/Reels-focused: optimized for creators needing fast, shareable clips without complex software.
- Integrated authentication and credit management; handles free and registered user flows.
- Real-time cloud rendering pipeline, with status updates and error handling.
- Supports batch editing, iterative refinements, and multiple file types for flexible workflows.
